description.value: Super India Sweets & Restaurant is an Abbotsford establishment specializing in traditional Punjabi recipes prepared with carefully sourced spices. The menu spans a wide range of vegetarian and non-vegetarian North Indian fare, from tandoori grills and biryanis to street-food classics like gol gappe and chaat papri. In addition to dine-in and online ordering, the restaurant offers large-scale catering for events including weddings and corporate gatherings.

address.value: 32883 South Fraser Way #105, Abbotsford, BC V2S 2A6
